name: @ffwd/api-client-server
description: Server core of the ffwd API client as an embeddable package: a fetch-function handler with server-held secret variables, Postman v2.1 import/export, and an SSRF proxy policy. No React, no DOM.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --external postman-collection --external quickjs-emscripten && bun build ./src/scripts/worker.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --external postman-collection --external quickjs-emscripten && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
